# Leene Square through the Telepod exhibit: the marle_joins replay,
# then south through the fair to the shopkeeper whose talk sets the
# Telepod gate flag (WRAM 7F0055 bit 7), north through the opened
# gate into the exhibit, and talk to Lucca (story 8 -> 10). Walk to
# Marle at the entrance and talk to her: her sequence runs the
# Telepod demonstration, she vanishes, and the story flag advances
# to 12. Ends at frame 96600 with WRAM 7F0000 = 0C.

# Leene Square through Marle joining the party: the leene_square replay
# to the bell, bump into Marle (pendant falls), talk to her, walk east to
# the pendant sparkle at tile (30, 8) and examine it, return the pendant,
# answer the choice, and name her Marle on the name-entry screen.
# Ends at frame 24000 with Marle in the party (WRAM 7E2981 = 01).
